request_messages.content:
Extract this person's own facts using only the vocabulary. "unknown" if not stated. Set attributes return a list. Return {"facts": {...}}.
- game_id (single): Skyforge_Arena = this person plays the game Skyforge Arena; Tidewatch = this person plays the game Tidewatch; Hollow_Lantern = this person plays the game Hollow Lantern
- mode (single): casual = this person plays casual, unranked matches; ranked = this person plays ranked, competitive matches
- comm_modes (set): text = this person communicates by text chat; voice = this person communicates by voice chat
- team_role (single): support = this person plays a support role; damage = this person plays a damage-dealing role; flexible = this person can play any role as needed
- coaching_role (single): none = this person wants no coaching either way; learn = this person wants to be coached (a learner); teach = this person is willing to coach others (a coach)
- time_window (set): sat_morning = free on Saturday morning; sat_afternoon = free on Saturday afternoon; sun_morning = free on Sunday morning; sun_afternoon = free on Sunday afternoon; weekday_evening = free on weekday evenings

Hey there! I’m Morgan, a mid‑30s Turkish gamer who loves running trails on my weekends and gaming on a console. I play Hollow Lantern in ranked matches and I’m happy to jump into any role—my style is flexible, I can fill whatever spot the team needs. I’m a chat‑only player, so I stick with text or voice chat during games—no coaching or teaching, just straight‑forward play. If you’re up for some competitive fun, I’m free every Saturday afternoon. Let’s team up and see how far we can climb together!

Extract (1) the requirements this person places on a partner: attribute, accepted_values (vocabulary values the PARTNER must hold), strength = required ONLY when the wording is unconditional (must / need / have to / only / no ... please / deal-breaker unless); strong_preference when it is called important but explicitly not required ('really matters ... though not a requirement', 'strongly prefer', 'big plus'); preference for light wishes ('nice if', 'small bonus', 'ideally'). Who does what: 'you to be the one who coaches me' means the PARTNER coaches (partner value teach); (2) changes_this_time: anything the person says is different from usual for THIS occasion, as attribute + their own value this time (empty list if none). Return {"requirements": [...], "changes_this_time": [...]}.
- game_id (single): Skyforge_Arena = this person plays the game Skyforge Arena; Tidewatch = this person plays the game Tidewatch; Hollow_Lantern = this person plays the game Hollow Lantern
- mode (single): casual = this person plays casual, unranked matches; ranked = this person plays ranked, competitive matches
- comm_modes (set): text = this person communicates by text chat; voice = this person communicates by voice chat
- team_role (single): support = this person plays a support role; damage = this person plays a damage-dealing role; flexible = this person can play any role as needed
- coaching_role (single): none = this person wants no coaching either way; learn = this person wants to be coached (a learner); teach = this person is willing to coach others (a coach)
- time_window (set): sat_morning = free on Saturday morning; sat_afternoon = free on Saturday afternoon; sun_morning = free on Sunday morning; sun_afternoon = free on Sunday afternoon; weekday_evening = free on weekday evenings

I need you to be into ranked matches, you must prioritize those games, and only if you’re into ranked it’s acceptable. I'd strongly prefer that you play a damage role, though it isn’t a requirement. It would matter a lot if you’re available Saturday afternoon, but I won’t rule you out over it. Nice if you’re into Hollow Lantern, but no big deal.
